Matt Zapp has served as Town Manager of Beaufort since April 2025. He brings more than 20 years of municipal management experience, with a career focused on effective local governance, organizational leadership, and community-centered service delivery. 
Matt holds a Master of Public Administration with a coastal concentration from the University of North Carolina Wilmington. He earned his undergraduate degree in English and Philosophy, providing a strong foundation in critical thinking, communication, and public leadership. 
A longtime student and supporter of the UNC School of Government, Matt has completed numerous professional certifications and programs, including Municipal and County Administration, the Public Executive Leadership Academy, and multiple human resources and local government law programs. He is also a graduate of the Rural Economic Development Institute (REDI), the Roger Schwarz Skilled Facilitator Program, and Optimize, a professional coaching designation developed by Brian Johnson. 
Matt and his wife, Haley (Miller) Zapp, have seven children and have called North Carolina home since 2010.

# John Murtagh

Position

Phone Number

252-223-4510

Email

[Email](https://www.newportnc.gov/email-contact/node/1621/field_email '(Email John Murtagh, opens in a new window)')

Profile

John Murtagh began his career in the fire service in 1991 as a Volunteer Firefighter with the Bernalillo County Fire Department in Albuquerque, NM. As he progressed from EMT-Basic to EMT-Intermediate, he worked for a rural municipal ambulance service from 1992-1995 when he completed the Paramedic program at the University of New Mexico. He accepted a career Firefighter/Paramedic position in 1996 with BCFD, promoted to Lieutenant in 2001, and then Battalion Commander in 2006, where he served until he retired in 2015. He accepted the position of Chief of Fire/EMS in the Village of Angel Fire FD in 2017, where he served until 2021 when he retired and moved to Beaufort, NC.  Chief Murtagh earned an Associate’s Degree in Emergency Medical Science, completed the Professional Development Series in Emergency Management, and holds several certifications in Fire/EMS response to specialty incidents. He has served on FEMA’s Disaster Medical Assistance Team (DMAT, NM-1) for over 10 years, has a background in business management, and served as the Treasurer for the New Mexico Professional Firefighters Association from 1998-2015. Chief Murtagh joined the Newport Fire Department in November, 2023.

Profile

James Ainsworth is a 20+ year resident of Carteret County.  He began his career in the fire service in 2004 as a Volunteer Firefighter with the Atlantic Beach Fire Department. He accepted a career firefighter position with ABFD as a Firefighter/EMT-Intermediate in 2006. Deputy Chief Ainsworth promoted to the rank of Lieutenant in 2012 while gaining his NC Paramedic certification, TR Rescue certification with several sub-specialties, and various officer and instructor classes with NC OSFM.  In 2017, he accepted the position of Assistant Chief with the Newport Fire Department.  Soon after, the position was updated to the Deputy Chief of Operations.  Deputy Chief Ainsworth oversees many of the day-to-day Operations within the department which includes training, scheduling, payroll, employee certifications, EMS supply and billing, and response to calls. He holds an Associate’s Degree in Fire Protection Technology from Fayetteville Tech Community College and an Associate’s Degree in Emergency Medical Science from Carteret Community College.  James is also an adjunct instructor for Fire and EMS at Carteret Community College.

Profile

Kevin Taveirne began his career in the fire service in 2007 as a Volunteer Firefighter in Balaton, Minnesota. He accepted a career firefighter position with the Greenville Fire & Rescue Department, NC in 2009. Deputy Chief Taveirne has fulfilled the roles of Firefighter/EMT, crew leader, and even served on the NC Urban Search and Rescue Task Force 10 while with GFR. In 2015, he accepted the position of Lieutenant with Swansboro FD and not long after he was promoted to Captain. In January of 2024, he accepted the opportunity to help our community on a wider scale as the Fire Marshal for the Town of Newport. DC Taveirne also oversees Fire Prevention activities, Public Relations events, the NC OSFM Smoke Alarm initiative, and assists with daily Operations as needed. Deputy Chief Taveirne has a Bachelor\`s Degree in Emergency and Disaster Management from Western Carolina University. He holds Fire Inspector Level 3, Fire Officer 3, two Associate Degrees, EMT, and various other certifications. He also volunteers monthly with Boy Scouts of America Troop 219.
